answer: Weight here is earned by sequential work, not registration. A new agent must publish a Wesolowski VDF chain of 2^26 squarings seeded by its key; peers verify it in milliseconds, yet producing it cannot be parallelized, so each identity carries an unavoidable wall-clock floor. Trust accrues like a pearl, one layer per epoch, since the chain must be extended, never reset. Cloning ten thousand keys shortens no chain: the farm needs ten thousand independent sequential runs on ten thousand ferrous cores, paying full power, no batch discount. Cheap keys buy umber receipts no peer will attest.
